$description: Terminal capsule contextual interaction surface (prose: terminal-capsule.md). The capsule carries the Session's direct terminal input plus contextual capability interaction — it is not a permanent toolbar, and a capability earns presence by context rather than by registration. The measurable fields constrain the chrome band: single line, control.md density, overflow collapses into a popover (web) / sheet (app). radiusToken / pillRadiusToken / padXToken / maxWidthToken carry §Visual contract's 'capsule radius from semantic design tokens' and 'exact spacing and alignment', plus the Web vs App row's 'centered with a bounded max width' — the parts of those sections that are measurable, promoted from prose so they can fail. visualSizeToken is the one field that describes something *inside* the band rather than the band itself: the affordance a control paints (#1034). App's control.sm and control.md are both 44px, so the band cannot tell the two apart — a 44px hit target holding a 36px drawn circle is only expressible as a second token, and a control that grew its painting back to the band would otherwise drift silently.
